decision_conditions: <p>Insufficient information has been provided to the satisfaction of the local planning authority that the proposed change of use to a dog grooming business and the loss of the industrial floorspace without reprovision would address an identified need in the local community which would not comply with the relevant provisions in the National Planning Policy Framework (2024) and Policy DM31.C of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>The proposed change of use, due to the lack of parking arrangements for the staff and customers and the lack of a safe delivery and servicing arrangements, would result in an unreasonable degree of impacts with regard to traffic and parking impact, contrary to Policy T4, T6 and T7 of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DM42.F and DM44 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>Insufficient information has been provided to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the proposed change of use of the site from storage to a dog grooming business would not result in an unreasonable degree of impacts with regard to noise and disturbance to the detriment of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policies D3, D13 and D14 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).&nbsp;</p>
description: Change of Use of garage at rear from Storage/Distribution (B8) to Dog Day Care & Grooming Facility (Sui Generis)
